note: [L] gets the bound with sup norms 400, 6.2 (not 1.079955, 1.414) and the weaker Chebyshev constants, so `6.7e6 N^{3/2} log N` replaces `7.3306 N^{3/2} log N`. The literal 7.3306 occurs only in `final_inequality`.

snippet.text:
theorem repSum_sub_le_of_bounds {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {Ap As : ℝ}
    (hAp : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |etaPlus t| ≤ Ap) (hAs : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → |etaStar t| ≤ As) :
    repSum (fun _ => True) N - repSum Good N ≤
      3 * (Ap ^ 2 * As) * Real.log N * (psi N - theta N + Real.log 2) * psi N := by

proof_context.conclusion: For `|η₊| ≤ Ap`, `|η_*| ≤ As`: even/non-prime part of the count `≤ 3 Ap² As log N (ψ(N)-θ(N)+log 2) ψ(N)` ([H, (14.51)] with constants as parameters).
